'''Gen Con 2003''' was the Gen Con gaming convention held at the Indiana Convention Center, 100 South Capitol Avenue, Indianapolis, from 24 to 27 July 2003. The [[Players Committee]] made it the host of the Star Wars CCG [[2003 North American Continental Championship|North American Continental Championships]] and of the 2003 World Championships of [[Young Jedi]] and the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]].<ref name="pc-gencon03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/gencon05282003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Gen Con 2003], swccgpc.com (28 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030713191047/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/gencon05282003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> The Committee announced on 23 March 2003 that both the Young Jedi and the Jedi Knights World Championships would be held at Gen Con,<ref name="pc-mar03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/march03archives.htm March Updates], swccgpc.com (23 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030819162615/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/march03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> and chose it to make those events as accessible as possible to their players.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />

In 2002 Gen Con had hosted a Star Wars CCG Open Qualifier that drew 64 participants.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Dates:''' 24–27 July 2003<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Venue:''' Indiana Convention Center, 100 South Capitol Avenue, Indianapolis<ref name="pc-gencon03" />

== Players Committee events ==

The Players Committee scheduled nine events at Gen Con 2003:<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* Thursday 24 July, 11am: Jedi Knights TCG [[Sealed Deck]], $5 entry; foils and other product for all.
* Thursday 24 July, 5pm: Young Jedi CCG Constructed Deck, $5 entry; foils, boosters and an uncut sheet.
* Thursday 24 July, 7pm: Star Wars CCG Sealed Deck ([[Secret Squirrel]]), $5 entry; foils and boosters for all.
* Friday 25 July, 10:30am: Young Jedi CCG Sealed Deck (Secret Squirrel), $5 entry; foils and other product for all.
* Friday 25 July, 3pm: Jedi Knights TCG World Championships, $5 entry; a $100 cash prize to the champion.
* Friday 25 July, 5pm: Star Wars CCG Constructed ([[Classic]]), $5 entry; foils, boosters and an uncut sheet.
* Saturday 26 July, 10am: Star Wars CCG [[2003 North American Continental Championship|North American Continental Championships]], $10 entry; a trip to the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]] at Dragon*Con.
* Saturday 26 July, 1pm: Young Jedi CCG World Championships, $5 entry; a $100 cash prize to the champion.
* Sunday 27 July, 10am: Gen Con Team Tournament, $25 per team; uncut sheets for the winning team.

Players could ask Tournament Support Advocate [[Andrew Howard]] to add further events to the schedule before 14 July 2003.<ref name="pc-gencon03" /> A schedule posted by [[Jim Colson]] on the PC forum on 20 June 2003 listed seven of these events, without the Jedi Knights and Young Jedi sealed deck events, and gave the Star Wars CCG Sealed Deck entry fee as $10. It added that the airfare paid for the Continental Champion would not exceed $300, subject to the Player Advocates' approval, and that the champion had to attend and play in the 2003 World Championships. To save money and processing time, the Committee asked players to buy Gen Con "generic" tickets, bring two of them to the tournament director of each PC event and pay the PC entry fee to that tournament director.<ref name="pcf-1062-29694">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=29694#29694 YJ Worlds], Jim Colson, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102222110/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Young Jedi and Jedi Knights World Championships ===

On 5 March 2003 a player posting as JasonRed3 announced on the PC forum that there would be a Young Jedi World Championship that year with a cash prize.<ref name="pcf-1062-18922">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18922#18922 YJ Worlds], JasonRed3, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102222110/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In March 2003 players on the forum, among them GFPComics, PloKeahey and Bubba Joe, argued that the Jedi Knights and Young Jedi World Championships would draw more players at a large event such as Gen Con; a player posting as ulkafett noted that Gen Con's deadline for submitting events was Friday 7 March 2003.<ref name="pcf-1061-18903">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18903#18903 JK Worlds at GenCon?], GFPComics, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050215141029/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45362%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1061-19213">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=19213#19213 JK Worlds at GenCon?], ulkafett, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050215141029/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45362%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1061-19262">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=19262#19262 JK Worlds at GenCon?], PloKeahey, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050215141029/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45362%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1061-19287">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=19287#19287 JK Worlds at GenCon?], Bubba Joe, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 March 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050215141029/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45362%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Each World Championship was six games of Swiss. Each winner was to receive $100 in cash, based on an attendance of 8 players per event; the prize could be decreased if fewer took part.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Young Jedi CCG:''' 1st place won a set of Young Jedi Premium foils, 2nd a set of Reflections foils, 3rd a set of ''Menace of Darth Maul'' BETA foils, 4th a set of ''Battle of Naboo'' foils, 5th a set of ''Jedi Council'' foils, 6th a set of ''Menace of Darth Maul'' foils and 7th a set of German ''Menace of Darth Maul'' cards (non-foil). Uncut sheets, including Reflections foils, were also among the prizes.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
* '''Jedi Knights TCG:''' 1st place won a set of GOLD foils, 2nd a set of SILVER foils and 3rd a set of First Day foils, each from Premiere, Scum & Villainy and Masters of the Force. Uncut sheets from the various expansions were also among the prizes.<ref name="pc-gencon03" />
In both events a higher-placed player could choose a lesser prize instead of the one for their place.<ref name="pc-gencon03" /><ref name="pcf-1062-29694" />

=== Team Tournament ===

The Gen Con Team Tournament was one of the Committee's three 2003 convention team tournaments, with those at [[2003 Origins|Origins]] and Dragon*Con. Taking part in any of them qualified a player for the 2004 Regional Team Championship, a new format planned for the 2004 North American Continental Championship at Gen Con, and each 2003 champion team was to receive a bye into its second day.<ref name="pc-team03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/teamchampionship06122003.htm Team Championship Qualifiers Planned for 2003], swccgpc.com (12 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809101318/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/teamchampionship06122003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

[[Damian Loback]] won the Star Wars CCG Classic constructed tournament.<ref name="pcf-377-31335">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31335#31335 What strategies are mostly viable in classic?], Chris Wodicka, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (5 August 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041217215857/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34439%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Matthew Delaney]] won the Young Jedi World Championship,<ref name="pcf-2011-31413">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31413#31413 Is the name of this year's YJ Champion a secret?], Andrew Howard, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 August 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105020948/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31388%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> which had six players.<ref name="pcf-1973-31042">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31042#31042 YJ World Championship Results?], taurik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040928104229/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31154%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
